related.title: OASIS STIX 2.1：亂序版本接收與同版本衝突隔離
related.titleEn: OASIS STIX 2.1: out-of-order version reception and conflicting-version quarantine
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付path-content.csv、hashset-manifest.json、lookup-v1.json、lookup-v2.json與classification-limitations.md；不分享真實受調查檔案。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver path-content.csv, hashset-manifest.json, lookup-v1.json, lookup-v2.json and classification-limitations.md. Use only synthetic file identities and do not redistribute real investigated files or sensitive evidence.
related.difference: 以物件ID加modified識別版本，固定來源身份政策，保存不可變歷史；對每次接收輸出advance、stale、duplicate或conflict決策及理由。
related.differenceEn: Identify versions by object ID plus modified, pin source-identity policy and preserve immutable history. For each received item, emit advance, stale, duplicate or conflict with an auditable reason.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Autopsy雜湊查找比對指定集合，集合內容改變可能需要重跑處理；命中表示與集合中內容相符，不證明環境、用途或執行行為無害。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有100條路徑、80個唯一內容雜湊；集合v1命中50個內容，分布在65條路徑。所有數值為人工可列舉的合成集合。 路徑命中率65/100=65%，內容命中率50/80=62.5%；兩者分母不同，不能把其中一個稱為完整安全率。

STIX 2.1定義物件版本與撤銷；本課衝突隔離為本地接收政策，並非用接收時間替代modified，也不以內容較長決定哪個版本可信。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 五個合成ID各有v1與v2，共10個不同版本；A到D先收v2再v1，E先v1再v2。每ID的v2是已知正確最新版，其中A的v2為撤銷。 按到達覆寫只讓E保持v2，最新版正確率1/5=20%；按版本選擇五個都保持v2，正確率5/5=100%，四個陳舊到達不應倒退狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Autopsy hash lookup compares files with configured sets, and changed sets may require ingest to run again. A match associates content with a set; it does not prove harmless context, use or execution behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 paths and eighty unique content hashes. Set v1 matches fifty distinct contents spread across sixty-five paths. Construct explicit synthetic sets so every count can be enumerated and checked. Path hit rate is 65/100=65%, while content hit rate is 50/80=62.5%. The denominators differ, and neither quantity is a comprehensive measure of security or benignness.

STIX 2.1 defines object versioning and revocation. Conflict quarantine is an explicit local receiver policy; arrival time must not replace modified, and longer content is not evidence that a competing version is trustworthy. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Five synthetic IDs each have v1 and v2, totaling ten distinct versions. A through D arrive v2 then v1; E arrives v1 then v2. Each v2 is the known latest version, including revoked A-v2. Arrival-order replacement leaves only E at v2, giving latest-state correctness 1/5=20%. Version-aware selection retains v2 for all five, giving 5/5=100%; four stale arrivals must not regress state.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Ceph: replica placement and correlated failure-domain enumeration

related.difference: 建立OSD到機架的映射，逐一枚舉機架故障時存活副本；區分至少一份可讀與符合指定服務策略的最低存活份數。
related.differenceEn: Map OSDs to racks and enumerate surviving replicas for each rack outage. Distinguish retaining at least one readable copy from satisfying the exercise service policy for minimum surviving copies.

Ceph透過placement groups及放置規則配置資料；本課用明確機架清單與最低兩份的教學服務門檻，不將其當成任何叢集預設。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A副本在R1,R2,R3，B在R1,R1,R2；三機架各輪流單獨故障一次，教學門檻為至少兩份存活。 A各次皆存活2份，通過3/3=100%；B失R1僅剩1，失R2剩2，失R3剩3，通過2/3=66.666667%。

A match associates content with a set; it does not prove harmless context, use or execution behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 paths and eighty unique content hashes. Set v1 matches fifty distinct contents spread across sixty-five paths. Construct explicit synthetic sets so every count can be enumerated and checked. Path hit rate is 65/100=65%, while content hit rate is 50/80=62.5%. The denominators differ, and neither quantity is a comprehensive measure of security or benignness.

Ceph uses placement groups and placement rules to place data. This fixture uses explicit rack locations and a two-copy teaching service threshold, not an assertion about any cluster default configuration. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A replicas are on R1,R2,R3; B replicas are on R1,R1,R2. Fail each of the three racks separately, requiring at least two surviving copies under the exercise policy. A retains two copies in every case and passes 3/3=100%. B retains one after R1 loss, two after R2 loss and three after R3 loss, passing 2/3=66.666667%.
